text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Of the six reported cases of overdosage, five cases had no adverse events reported; nonserious adverse events in the sixth case (a single dose of 1.3 mg/kg) included decreased levels of blood potassium and blood albumin, and increased levels of carbon dioxide, blood lactate dehydrogenase, blood urea, blood phosphorus, blood sodium, and blood alkaline phosphatase. Monitor patients who receive an overdose and initiate supportive measures if required.
